# Reference values for the RSTAB test models (generated by `scripts/rstab/test-models.ts`)

Units N, mm. Section 150x150x5 box: A = 2878.5 mm², I = 10050400 mm⁴, J = 15372700 mm⁴, A_y = A_z = 1213 mm²; E = 210000, G = 80769.23 N/mm². EI = 2.11058e+12 N·mm². "Solver" = the second-order frame solver of this application (Theory II). Closed form = Euler-Bernoulli beam-column solution (Timoshenko & Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability, beam-columns; Chen & Lui, Structural Stability); the solver "no shear" columns use the same assumptions.

## TM1 cantilever column (L = 4000 mm, fixed base, free top; P = 130 kN compression, H = 2 kN at the top)
P_cr (cantilever Euler) = 325.48 kN, P/P_cr = 0.3994, k = √(P/EI) = 2.48182e-4 1/mm, kL = 0.99273

| Quantity | Closed form | Solver, 1 element, no shear | 2 el. | 4 el. | 16 el. | 4 el., with shear |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First order: top displacement u_x [mm] | 20.2156 | 20.2156 | 20.2156 | 20.2156 | 20.2156 | 20.2972 |
| First order: base moment [kN·m] | 8.0000 | 8.0000 | 8.0000 | 8.0000 | 8.0000 | 8.0000 |
| Second order: top displacement u_x [mm] | 33.4772 | 33.4164 | 33.4727 | 33.4769 | 33.4772 | 33.6772 |
| Second order: base moment [kN·m] | 12.3520 | 12.3441 | 12.3515 | 12.3520 | 12.3520 | 12.3780 |
| Amplification of the top displacement (2nd / 1st) | 1.6560 | 1.6530 | 1.6558 | 1.6560 | 1.6560 | 1.6592 |

Formulas: first order u = H L³/(3EI), M = H L. Second order u = (H/(P k)) (tan kL − kL), M_base = (H/k) tan kL. TM2 (RSTAB imperfection): H = φ0 P = P/200 = 0.65 kN at the top only (the equal and opposite end force of RSTAB's equivalent loads acts at the support), values by the same formulas with H = 0.65 kN:
closed form second order u = 10.8801 mm, M_base = 4.0144 kN·m; solver (4 el., no shear) u = 10.8800 mm, M_base = 4.0144 kN·m.

## TM3 simply supported beam-column (L = 4000 mm, UDL q = 5 N/mm downward, P = 0.5 P_E = 650.96 kN compression)
P_E = π²EI/L² = 1301.91 kN; u = kL/2 = 1.11072

| Quantity | Closed form | Solver 1 el. | 2 el. | 4 el. | 8 el. |  (first-order solver rows: see finding F-1)
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First order: maximum moment [kN·m] | 10.0000 | 14.1123 | 14.0978 | 11.2232 | 10.3182 |
| Second order: maximum moment [kN·m] | 20.2994 | 16.9847 | 20.2187 | 20.2941 | 20.2991 |
| Second order: maximum moment / first-order moment | 2.0299 | 1.2035 | 1.4342 | 1.8082 | 1.9673 |

Formulas: first order M = q L²/8; second order M_max = (q/k²)(sec(kL/2) − 1), k = √(P/EI). (The solver table reports the moment of the element stations; with 1 element only the end values exist, so the mid-span moment appears from 2 elements on. RSTAB "second order P-Δ" is expected to need member divisions to reproduce P-δ: this model exists to show it.)

## TM4 braced bay: two cantilever columns, pinned beam, one N-only (tension-only) diagonal 2L 50x50x5
Geometry: columns at x = 0 and x = 4000, height 4000; pinned beam (rotations about local y, z released at both ends); H = 6 kN horizontal at the top-left node; 130 kN vertical at each top node. Diagonal length 5656.9 mm.
First-order hand check (diagonal active): K = 2·3EI/h³ + E A cos²θ/L_d = 197.867 + 17781.968 = 17979.835 N/mm → u = H/K = 0.3337 mm; with the diagonal inactive u = H/(2·3EI/h³) = 30.3234 mm.

| Case | Solver u_x top-left [mm] | Axial force in the diagonal [kN] (tension +) | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| A. no gravity, H toward +x, diagonal stretched (active), first order (hand check 0.3337 mm) | 0.4117 | 8.376 | converged |
| B. no gravity, H toward −x, diagonal compressed: N-only switches it off, first order (hand check 30.3234 mm) | 0 | 0 | NOT converged: Load step λ=0.000000→0.015625 did not converge: iteration limit of 100 reached without convergence. |
| B2. as B but the diagonal is an ordinary truss (acts in compression too), first order | -0.4117 | -8.376 | converged |
| C. gravity 130 kN per column + H toward +x, first order (the diagonal is first compressed by the column shortening, so it is inactive until H stretches it) | 1.2609 | 8.139 | converged |
| C2. same, second order | 1.2673 | 8.277 | converged |
| D. gravity + H toward −x, first order | 0 | 0 | NOT converged: Load step λ=0.000000→0.015625 did not converge: iteration limit of 100 reached without convergence. |
| D2. same, second order | -50.5257 | 0 | converged |

## TM5 fixed-base portal (columns 4000 mm, beam 6000 mm, all 150x150x5, rigid joints), H = 5 kN at the beam level, in the X-Z plane and in the Y-Z plane
First-order closed form (slope-deflection, antisymmetric sway): u = H h³ (2 + 3k) / (12 E I_c (1 + 6k)), k = I_b h /(I_c L) = 0.6667 → u = 10.1078 mm.

| Case | Sway [mm] | Largest base moment [kN·m] | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
Closed form including the shear deformation of the two columns (each carries H/2): + (H/2) h /(G A_y) = 0.1021 mm → 10.2099 mm (the beam shear adds a little more).
| X-Z plane, first order, H only, NO shear deformation (closed form 10.1078 mm) | 10.1249 | 6.0074 | converged |
| X-Z plane, first order, H only | 10.2487 | 6.0131 | converged |
| Y-Z plane, first order, H only (must equal the X-Z result) | 10.2487 | 6.0131 | converged |
| X-Z plane, second order, H and 100 kN on each beam end | 11.5820 | 6.6524 | converged |
